prompt: Match each maxmemory eviction policy to its behavior under memory pressure.
explanation: noeviction protects data by rejecting writes; allkeys-* choose victims across every key regardless of TTL; volatile-* only evict among keys that carry an expiry; and lfu variants track access frequency instead of recency.

pairs.right: Rejects write commands once memory reaches maxmemory
Evicts the least recently used key among all keys
Evicts the least recently used key among keys with a TTL
Evicts the least frequently used key among all keys
Evicts, among keys with a TTL, those closest to expiry first
